title: EMEA Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner - GTM
description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Location: London, UK
 This is a 9 month FTC role
 About the Role:
 We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner to join our London-based EMEA team in a fixed-term capacity. Acting as a strategic talent advisor, you will help drive the expansion of our GTM and G&A teams across the EMEA region with full autonomy. title: Senior Account Executive, Hotels
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join:
 The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping independent, boutique hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.
 The Difference You Will Make:
 As a Senior Account Executive, you will be responsible for converting leads into net‑new supply to support new-market launches and at pace to hit quarterly goals for the Airbnb Hotels team in Japan. Working the full sales funnel, you will proactively turn cold leads into warm sales opportunities helping to build the Hotels category’s market presence in the process through collaboration with other teams. This includes partnering, strategizing, and running daily operations directly with independent, boutique hotels , and ensuring that Airbnb sources the best hotel inventory available to our guests.
 A Typical Day:
 Meet and exceed KPIs by owning the performance and success of Japan
 Prospect new potential hotels through external research, networking, and use of Airbnb tools
 Securing new hotels involves targeted sales strategies and negotiating and closing the deals
 Develops acquisition strategies and scalable, localised supply strategies for established and emergi…

title: Senior National Account Manager
description:
The Practical Detail
Location: Hybrid | Remote
 Why this role matters
In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide.
 What you'll do
 Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth.
 Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in.
 Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities.
 Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams.
 Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume.
 Performance
You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth.
 Care
You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and deman…

title: Kundendienstmitarbeiter Forderungsmanagement (m/w/d)
description:
Gemeinsam halten wir Prozesse in Bewegung.
 Die UAI SOLUTIONS Firmengruppe entwickelt und betreibt innovative Lösungen für Mobilität, Verwaltungsprozesse und internationale Dienstleistungen in Europa. Unser Ziel ist es, Mobilität einfacher, transparenter und effizienter zu gestalten.
 Dabei stehen Menschen, Verantwortung, Zusammenarbeit und nachhaltige Lösungen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Unsere Vision lautet „Smart solutions for seamless mobility“. Mit innovativen End-to-End-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Prozesse einfach, nachvollziehbar und zuverlässig umzusetzen. Dazu gehört auch, offene mobilitätsbezogene Vorgänge mit den Fahrzeughaltern unserer Kunden transparent und möglichst reibungslos zu klären.
 Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine engagierte Persönlichkeit für den Bereich Forderungsmanagment .
 Aufgaben
 Bearbeitung und Überwachung offener Forderungen im In- und Ausland
 Schriftliche und telefonische Kommunikation mit Schuldnern
 Fachkompetente Beratung der Schuldner
 Sicherstellung der Qualitätsanforderungen des Auftraggebers und der Kundenzufriedenheit
 Erfassung der Geschäftsvorfälle in der Unternehmenssoftware
 Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Prozesse im Forderungsmanagement
 Qualifikation
 Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
 Erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich Inkasso / Forderungsmanagement von Vorteil
 Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere Excel
 Sorgfältige, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
 Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und Durchsetzungsvermögen
 Gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
 Benefits
 Abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit internationalem Bezug
 Motiviertes, kollegiales Team mit flachen Hierarchien
 Homeoffice
 Mitarbeiterevents & kleine Aufmerksamkeiten im Alltag
 Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
 Bezuschusste betriebliche Altervorsorge
